summary: Short flat kerb on a quiet street, with homes 12-14 m away.
reasons: Homes 12-14 m away on both sides
No cars seen parked on this kerb
Flat, but only a short gap

best_section.where: South kerb of Cunningham Street, in front of the tree-lined frontages mid-stretch

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 12 m and 14 m away on the south side, plus houses and apartments across the road at 10-30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is open in the imagery; trees and fences leave only the lane width, so room to pull off is plain kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; cross street at the west end.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north kerb, none seen on this one; weekday daytime no-parking sign only.

flags: Weekday 7am-6pm no-parking sign; overnight not covered
Dwellings at 7-8 m just beyond each end
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb from the south side; open to afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether kerb parking is tolerated overnight
